summary: Magnum Ice Cream Co N.V. filed a Form 6-K containing a stock exchange announcement of Director/PDMR Shareholding. The filing discloses routine share acquisitions by two PDMRs—Vanessa Vilar (Chief Legal Officer) and Julien Barraux (Chief Creative Officer)—on 13-14 May 2026 at prices between EUR 12.60 and EUR 12.70 per ordinary share. No board recommendation, advisor, or strategic event is mentioned. This is a standard disclosure of insider transactions under market abuse regulations, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, premiums, or restructuring mechanics. The filing is purely a notification of managerial share dealings.
